promotion_requires: Complete 24-layer Qwen2-style accelerator generated from trusted Chisel templates without silently changing model semantics.
Elaborated SystemVerilog and real functional verification evidence using a real simulator selected by the toolchain team.
Real Vivado synthesis, implementation, and bitstream generation evidence on server 23 for the VU9P board part.
Board execution evidence from the Qwen AXI/DDR wrapped system, with no deadlock or timeout and a valid output accepted by the run's Qwen validity checker.

debug_and_repair_policy.repair_rule: A failed layer must use real tool output, CCTG/contract-guided localization, bounded repair, and rerun until correct before promotion.
required_loop: Layer 3: board-accurate AXI/DDR wrapped system third.

design_goal: Build a complete board-runnable spatial FPGA accelerator design package for a Qwen2-0.5B-style decoder-only LLM at target_max_seq_len 16, preserving the provided 24-layer Qwen2 semantics, generating Chisel/SystemVerilog from trusted templates, running real Vivado synthesis/implementation/bitstream generation on server 23 for the VU9P board part, and obtaining board-valid output evidence through a connected Qwen AXI/DDR wrapper.
human_inputs: human_task_spec: Design a complete board-runnable spatial accelerator for a Qwen2-style decoder-only LLM.

human_task_spec: Target model source is Qwen2-0.5B style with 24 decoder layers, hidden_size 896, grouped-query attention with 14 query heads and 2 KV heads, head_dim 64, RoPE, RMSNorm, and gated SiLU MLP.
human_task_spec: First automation target uses target_max_seq_len 16 from the model_config.

human_task_spec: Framework must generate a Qwen spatial accelerator design package from trusted Chisel templates, elaborate SystemVerilog, run real Vivado synthesis/implementation/bitstream generation on server 23 for the VU9P board part, and record all tool evidence.
human_task_spec: Do not run OPT full-sequence verification as Qwen evidence, and do not claim board runtime pass until a Qwen AXI/DDR board wrapper is connected and checked.
hardware_model_facts: model_type qwen2; num_layers 24; hidden_size 896; target_max_seq_len 16; decoder block with pre RMSNorm, causal GQA attention, RoPE, and gated SiLU MLP.
hardware_model_facts provenance: _llm_provenance mode llm, sub_agent model_config_agent, used_fallback false.
notes: The current Layer-3 run is one complete Transformer block at validation layer index 0 through the exact AXI/DDR board wrapper; the immutable model/catalog authority remains the complete 24-layer target.
No bit-exact numeric matching was explicitly requested; acceptance is based on no-deadlock and valid-output evidence, with checker configuration recorded by the run.

For the scoped board validation workload, derive layer/token/beat counts from the board validation scope; require complete scoped runtime/weight flow, token overlap, final writeback, and valid known output. Golden numeric comparison is diagnostic only and must not gate board pass.
Precision, quantization, rounding mode, and numeric tolerances were not specified in the supplied materials and must not be invented silently.

Exact VU9P FPGA part number, DDR/AXI data width, board shell/runtime, clock targets, tokenizer/checkpoint identity, and host software details were not specified; keep these unknown until provided or generated with recorded assumptions.
OPT full-sequence verification must not be used or reported as Qwen evidence.
Board runtime pass cannot be claimed until the Qwen AXI/DDR board wrapper is connected, checked, and used for board-valid output evidence.
No material conflict was identified between human_task_spec and hardware_model_facts.
required_outputs: Generated Qwen spatial accelerator design package from trusted Chisel templates for the full 24-layer target at target_max_seq_len 16.
Elaborated SystemVerilog for the generated accelerator and its Qwen AXI/DDR board wrapper.

Configuration/model manifest preserving the Qwen2 model facts: GQA 14 query heads and 2 KV heads, head_dim 64, RoPE theta 1000000.0, RMSNorm eps 1e-6, gated SiLU MLP intermediate_size 4864, and the provided decoder operator order.
Real functional verification logs and pass/fail evidence for operator/leaf modules, connected single-transformer-layer kernel, and board-accurate AXI/DDR wrapped system.
Real Vivado synthesis, implementation, timing/utilization/report, and bitstream-generation logs from server 23 for the VU9P board part.
Bitstream artifact evidence, including generated artifact path/name and associated Vivado run evidence.
Board execution transcript/logs from the connected Qwen AXI/DDR wrapper showing no deadlock or timeout.
Board-valid output evidence for the Qwen run, with checker configuration and result recorded; OPT full-sequence results are not acceptable as Qwen evidence.
Failure localization and bounded repair records if any verification or implementation step fails before final promotion.

toolchain_requirements.functional_verification_tool: VCS or Verilator; exact selection not specified in supplied materials
